1.explanation:
• Pagination/Pagination.mdx & Pagination/docs/overview.mdx – Contains the primary component documentation, including the `pagesUnknown` prop and usage examples, so you can see how this mode is intended to work.
• PaginationNav/docs/overview.mdx – Shows the navigation controls (prev/next arrows) and how they integrate with the page selector when pages are unknown.
• Select/Select.mdx & Select/docs/overview.mdx – The Pagination component uses a Select under the hood for page selection. Reviewing its API helps understand the dropdown’s behavior and prop mappings.
• Text/Text.mdx – The repeated page number is rendered as a Text component; this doc shows text styling and usage within other components.
1.bug_scenario:
When using the Pagination component with the prop `pagesUnknown={true}`, the current page number is rendered twice: once in the Select dropdown (e.g. “1”, “2”, “3”…) and then immediately again as a text label (“page 1”, “page 2”, “page 3”). The screenshots show that selecting a page updates both the dropdown and the repeated text, leading to redundant display.

In the first image, the dropdown shows “1” and it is followed by the label “page 1”. In subsequent images, changing the dropdown to “2” or “3” updates both elements, causing “2 page 2” and “3 page 3” side by side.
